issues.detail: The runner disables sync and common logger settings, but BaseTrainer still registers Platform integration. The reviewed platform.py on_pretrain_routine_start directly uses an inherited ULTRALYTICS_API_KEY or settings api_key, independently of sync=False. This leaves an outbound logging/upload callback route in a nominally offline smoke. No key was read or displayed during this review.
